text: 女人的性别属性是有起止寿命的。
en: A woman's gender attribute has a finite lifespan with a beginning and an end.

text: 从16岁开始，到36岁结束。
en: It begins at 16 and ends at 36.

text: 16岁之前和36岁之后的女性趋近于中性。
en: Women before 16 and after 36 tend toward the neutral.

text: 身体寿命或许很长，性别寿命是短暂的。
en: The bodily lifespan may be long, but the gender lifespan is brief.

text: 婚恋市场上40岁的女人有两种：
en: On the marriage and dating market, women of 40 come in two types:

text: A. 时间赋予她积累财富和地位的机会，面容上岁月的痕迹浅淡，眉眼之间风情更胜。
en: A. Time has given her the chance to accumulate wealth and status; the traces of years upon her face are faint, and her charm between the brows is even greater.

text: 待人态度从容，遇事杀伐果断。
en: She treats others with composure and acts with decisive resolve when matters arise.

text: 她找伴侣的目的是分享生活的美好。
en: Her purpose in seeking a partner is to share the beauty of life.

text: B. 未被岁月善待的人。
en: B. Those whom the years have not treated kindly.

text: 经济局促，身心狼狈。
en: Strained finances, body and mind in disarray.

text: 她找伴侣的目的是被拯救。
en: Her purpose in seeking a partner is to be saved.

text: 很可惜，B类更众
en: Regrettably, type B is the more numerous.

text: 婚恋市场上男人也分两种：
en: On the marriage and dating market, men too fall into two types:

text: A. 无生育需求的。
en: A. Those with no procreation needs.

text: B. 有生育需求的。
en: B. Those with procreation needs.

text: B占了大多数，无论A女B女，他们都只能投弃权票。
en: B makes up the majority; whether type-A women or type-B women, they can only abstain from the vote.

text: 只有少数A男中的精英，他们会考虑A女。
en: Only a few elites among type-A men will consider type-A women.

text: 可A女在市场上本就罕见，两人又都是高需求者，相互契合的难度徒增。
en: Yet type-A women are already rare on the market, and since both are high-demand individuals, the difficulty of mutual fit increases greatly.

text: 最后能在一起的，就变成了the one，这种组合自然成不了普遍。
en: Those who finally end up together become 'the one', and naturally such pairings cannot become the norm.

text: 取决于他们的认知水平。
en: It depends on their level of awareness.

text: 我认识一个投资界大佬，四十多岁，有钱且不油腻。
en: I know a big shot in the investment world, in his forties, wealthy and not greasy.

text: 我不能描述太多，说多了知乎上会有人根据画像猜到。
en: I cannot describe too much; if I say more, someone on Zhihu will piece it together from the profile.

text: 他这样的一堆女人生扑，但他偏偏不喜欢那些生扑的年轻漂亮的姑娘和网红。
en: A flock of women throw themselves at him, yet he specifically dislikes those young, pretty girls and internet celebrities who throw themselves at him.

text: 觉得她们没有灵魂。
en: He feels they have no soul.

text: 熟悉他的人都知道他暗恋他们公司一个年近四十的姐姐。
en: Those who know him well all know he has a secret crush on an older sister at their company who is nearly forty.

text: 这姐姐知性优雅，对任何事情都有自己的见解与判断能力，能迅速抽丝剥茧解决问题。
en: This older sister is intellectual and elegant, has her own views and judgement on any matter, and can swiftly unravel problems to their core.

text: 关键是，这姐姐已婚夫妻和睦儿女双全，大佬只能默默关注她。
en: The key point is, this older sister is married, with a harmonious couple and both son and daughter; the big shot can only quietly follow her.

text: 一个阿弟。
en: A younger brother.

text: 体制内。
en: Within the system.

text: 实权部门正处。
en: A full division chief in a department with real power.

text: 转业军官。
en: A demobilised military officer.

text: 帝都。
en: The imperial capital.

text: 八一互祝节日快乐的时候。
en: When they exchanged Army Day greetings on the first of August.

text: 聊了几句。
en: We chatted a few words.

text: 他说刘亦菲我都不要。
en: He said he wouldn't want even Liu Yifei.

text: 我说为啥。
en: I asked why.

text: 他说四十岁，不惑之年，美色有几年，什么狗屁情绪价值，他随便走到哪里，到处都是提供情绪价值的。
en: He said, at forty, the age of no doubts, beauty lasts but a few years; what bloody emotional value — wherever he goes there are people offering emotional value everywhere.

text: 不是女人年龄贬值。
en: It is not that women depreciate with age.

text: 而是大家想的都不在一起了。
en: Rather, what everyone wants no longer aligns.

text: 一群00后不好，找个老娘们还哄她，是他傻福还是我傻福。
en: A bunch of post-00s aren't any good; to find some old dame and still pander to her — is that his dumb luck or my dumb luck.

text: 我无言以对。
en: I was speechless.

text: 为什么要纠结40岁的男人和女人。
en: Why obsess over men and women of forty.

text: 1、40岁的男人，你身价千万，又高又有腹肌，还有颜值，还有社会地位，一大把20岁的小姑娘追。
en: 1. A forty-year-old man, worth tens of millions, tall with abs, good looks, and social status — a great many twenty-year-old girls chase after you.

text: 2、40岁的女人，你身价千万，又高又美，能给情绪价值，一大把20岁的小男孩追。
en: 2. A forty-year-old woman, worth tens of millions, tall and beautiful, able to provide emotional value — a great many twenty-year-old boys chase after you.

text: 别跟我杠，换做是你，你愿不愿意。
en: Don't argue with me; if it were you, would you be willing or not.

text: 底层逻辑，就是自己弱爆了，还在这里挑三拣四。
en: The underlying logic is simply that you're hopelessly weak yet still here being picky.

text: 以前是劳动人民不想嫁，剥削阶级不想娶，现在残存的唯一价值生育价值都未必还有，劳动人民也不想娶了。
en: In the past, the working people did not want to marry and the exploiting class did not want to take wives; now even the one remaining value, procreative value, may no longer exist, and the working people no longer want to marry either.

text: 我认识一个女人，保养极好，生活非常幸福，在普通人里几乎所有面板都是顶级的六边形美少女战士，45了，虽然身材还是没走样，美人胚子还在，颜值依旧非常能打，但是没化妆的时候，脸已经没办法细看了。
en: I know a woman who takes extremely good care of herself and lives very happily; among ordinary people nearly every attribute panel of hers is top-tier, a hexagonal warrior maiden — at 45, though her figure has not gone out of shape, her beautiful bone structure remains and her looks are still very striking, yet without makeup her face can no longer bear close scrutiny.

text: 不能说100%，但可以说99%的男性结婚考虑的就是生育，我觉得这没什么难以启齿的，结婚不为了繁衍下一代，那结婚干嘛？
en: I won't say 100%, but I can say 99% of men marry with procreation in mind; I don't think there's anything shameful about this — if you don't marry to reproduce the next generation, then why marry?

text: 当然了，会有那么1%的男性结婚并不是为了繁衍，南通？
en: Of course, there are those 1% of men who marry not for reproduction — Nantong?

text: 丁克？
en: DINK?

text: 这些是个人选择，尊重。
en: These are personal choices; respect them.

text: 所以说，几乎所有男性结婚就是奔着传宗接代去的，这和女性都想嫁一个条件好的男人，都想跨越阶层是一样的，这是人之常情，谁不想嫁个好老公？
en: So nearly all men marry with the aim of carrying on the family line, and this is the same as women all wanting to marry a man of good standing and to cross class boundaries — this is only human nature; who wouldn't want to marry a good husband?

text: 都可以理解。
en: All of this is understandable.

text: 回到问题本身，40岁的女性生育价值不高了，高龄产妇生育风险不是一般的大，是个正常有理性想繁衍后代的男性基本都不可能选择40岁的女性。
en: Returning to the question itself: the procreative value of a forty-year-old woman is no longer high, and the risks of childbirth for an older mother are extraordinarily great; essentially no normal, rational man who wants to reproduce could possibly choose a forty-year-old woman.

text: 再次强调，这没什么难以启齿的，这和男性娶不到老婆大多是因为经济问题一样。
en: To emphasise again, there is nothing shameful about this; it is the same as how most men who cannot find a wife do so mainly because of financial problems.

text: 所以，男性要想结婚，就清醒点，把重心放在事业上，搞钱上，有钱选择就多了，我并不是说女性都物质，咱就是说谁不想自己的伴侣比别人的优秀呢？
en: So men who want to marry should be clear-headed, put their focus on their career, on making money; with money come more choices. I'm not saying women are all materialistic — I just mean, who wouldn't want their partner to be better than others'.

text: 女性要想结婚，就应该趁着自己还在最佳的生育年龄，32-33之前吧，再晚生育后恢复就比较慢了，赶紧找个靠谱的的男的结婚是真的。
en: Women who want to marry should do so while still within their optimal childbearing age, before 32 or 33 — any later and recovery after childbirth is slower; quickly finding a reliable man to marry is the real thing.

text: 简而言之，男的搞钱为重，女的早结婚。
en: In short: for men, making money is paramount; for women, marry early.

text: 某高端相亲局 3000w闭门高端相亲局”有严格的准入门槛如下↓
en: A certain high-end matchmaking event, a 30-million closed-door high-end matchmaking event, has strict entry thresholds as follows: ↓

text: 男生需验资，验资标准如下：
en: For men, assets must be verified; the verification standards are as follows:

text: 个人+父母资产3kw+或
en: Personal + parents' assets of 30 million+ or

text: 个人年收入200w+或
en: Personal annual income of 2 million+ or

text: 同时满足个人+父母资产2kw+及个人年收入100w+
en: Simultaneously meeting personal + parents' assets of 20 million+ and personal annual income of 1 million+

text: 女生需面试，筛选标准如下：
en: For women, an interview is required; the screening standards are as follows:

text: 1、高颜值
en: 1. High looks

text: 2、95年及以后出生
en: 2. Born in 1995 or later

text: 3、985、211、QS Top200或同等级艺术类高校
en: 3. 985, 211, QS Top 200, or an equivalent-tier arts university

text: 4、个人➕父母资产1kw+
en: 4. Personal + parents' assets of 10 million+

text: （以上4条需至少满足3条）
en: (At least 3 of the above 4 must be met)

text: 女生通过面试后可享免单参与，而男生通过验资后需付费参与。
en: Women who pass the interview may participate free of charge, whereas men who pass asset verification must pay to participate.

text: 女生主要是颜值及年龄，男生则是只有资产要求，男生对女生的要求永远只有一条
en: For women it is mainly looks and age; for men there is only the asset requirement. The requirement men have of women is forever just one thing:

text: 年轻漂亮
en: Young and beautiful

text: 以前隔壁有个姐姐，和我讲了她二婚的故事。
en: Previously, an older sister next door told me the story of her second marriage.

text: 那年她离婚，46岁吧差不多，女儿上大学，后来也是姐妹介绍，说身边有个钻石王老五，短婚，没孩子，五十出头，但是因为有钱，人也保养的好，看着不像那么大的。
en: That year she divorced, at around 46, her daughter at university; later a sister introduced her, saying there was a diamond bachelor nearby — briefly married, no children, just over fifty, but because he was wealthy and took good care of himself, he didn't look that old.

text: 之所以也单了好几年，是因为第一，他不想找太小的，觉得还是沟通有代沟。
en: The reason he had been single for several years was, first, that he didn't want to find someone too young, feeling there was still a generational gap in communication.

text: 但是也不想找一个年纪大了，长的也大了的，就是说你可以四十岁，但是看起来最好只有三十多。
en: But he also didn't want someone whose age was advanced and whose looks had aged — meaning you could be forty, but you'd best look only in your thirties.

text: 那个姐姐的条件真是完美契合，
en: That older sister's conditions were a perfect fit,

text: 大眼睛，身材微胖，但是特别有型，看起来也就三十几岁，而且爱笑，还会撒娇，所以第一面见，两个人就都觉得不错。
en: Big eyes, a slightly plump but very shapely figure, looking only in her thirties, and she loved to laugh and could act coquettish; so at the first meeting both felt it was good.

text: 但是后来两个人结婚也就一年多，还是离了。
en: But later the two were married only a little over a year before they divorced again.

text: 她说，还是不合适，两个人都有各自的生活经历，也有各自的习惯，所以过了一段时间还是觉得不合适，不想互相迁就，就离了。
en: She said they were still incompatible; both had their own life experiences and their own habits, so after a while they still felt incompatible, didn't want to accommodate each other, and divorced.

text: 现在一个人，活的自由自在。
en: Now alone, living free and unfettered.
